nodes.label: Android Icon Background - Brand Guidelines Asset
nodes.description: Android adaptive icon background layer for TandemPay mobile app. Light sky-blue background (#E8F4FD) with geometric construction guide lines rendered in a matching blue tone. Shows concentric circles and dashed diagonal/vertical alignment guides — standard Android adaptive icon safe-zone template. Brand color: pale/light blue. Design style: clean, minimal, flat. Used as the background layer behind the foreground icon artwork.
